exercises.instruction: Make a file readable, writable, and executable for owner only
exercises.instruction_id: Jadikan file readable, writable, dan executable hanya untuk owner

exercises.instruction: Give read permission to all users for 'data.txt'
exercises.instruction_id: Beri izin baca untuk semua user pada 'data.txt'
expected_output: Added read permission for all users.

exercises.instruction: View detailed file permissions with ls
exercises.instruction_id: Lihat detail izin file dengan ls

exercises.instruction: Change file owner to root (requires root)
exercises.instruction_id: Ubah owner file ke root (butuh root)

exercises.instruction: Make all .sh files in current directory executable
exercises.instruction_id: Jadikan semua file .sh di direktori ini executable
exercises.hint: * is a wildcard that matches any characters
exercises.hint_id: * adalah wildcard yang cocok dengan karakter apa saja

exercises.hint: 6=rw-, 4=r--. Owner can read/write, others read only
exercises.hint_id: 6=rw-, 4=r--. Owner bisa baca/tulis, lainnya hanya baca

exercises.instruction: Remove write permission for group on 'data.csv'
exercises.instruction_id: Hapus izin tulis untuk grup pada 'data.csv'

exercises.instruction: Recursively change permissions of 'project' directory to 755
exercises.instruction_id: Ubah izin direktori 'project' secara rekursif ke 755
expected_output: Recursively changed permissions of 'project/' to rwxr-xr-x.
exercises.hint: -R = recursive, applies to all files and subdirectories
exercises.hint_id: -R = rekursif, berlaku untuk semua file dan subdirektori

exercises.instruction: View permissions in numeric format for 'app.py'
exercises.instruction_id: Lihat izin dalam format numerik untuk 'app.py'
